content.comment_body: Hello, I am seeking advice regarding [product_name] software. In my project, I want to modify parameter values of a functional block depending on a digital input signal. For instance, when a pushbutton (I1) is activated, I want a Weekly Timer's cam 1 to include Monday or similar functionality. Any guidance is appreciated!
Which [product_name] hardware version are you using? So far you’ve mentioned only the software version, but not the hardware type ([article_no] or another version).
I'm using a [product_name] [article_no]. If this isn't feasible, is there alternative hardware or software that allows such functionality?
You can toggle each weekday (on or off) via the display in a message text. Perhaps this approach will be sufficient for your needs.

Thank you for the example. When testing, I can only view the parameters for cam 1, but I’m unable to modify them as the program runs. I'd like the ability to change these parameters directly during operation, rather than accessing them through manual steps in the program menus.
You don't have to use menus; it is possible to change this parameter when the device is in RUN mode. Just select the message text that contains the relevant parameters.
I'm still unsure. I’m running the program on my [product_name] unit and have the message text displayed, but I can’t seem to navigate or adjust anything using the device buttons.

You need to embed the parameters you wish to change within a message text (refer to the provided attachment). To modify a parameter, select the required message. Hold the ESC key for more than 2 seconds; a black bar will then appear in an input or output field. Use the up/down cursor to move between fields. To change a field, press the OK (or Enter) button. The black bar will turn into a blinking cursor. Use the up/down cursor to adjust values, and left/right to change selection. Once done, press OK again to go back to the black bar. You can continue adjusting other fields or exit the operation with ESC.

Hello, here's a practical example: After downloading to [product_name], hold ESC for over 1 second to allow modification of day, Ton, and Toff parameters of Cam1 in a weekly timer. This is a basic topic, and I recommend trying the [product_name] Web-Based Training (WBT) for foundational skills. Gaining experience with [product_name] will also help inspire improvements to your project.
Thank you! Holding down the ESC button to select and modify a message text parameter was exactly what I needed. Also thanks to [user_name]—I’ll check out the recommended resources.
